## Core Fullstack Principles
- [ ] End-to-End Type Safety: Shared type definitions between API routes and UI components.
- [ ] API Boundaries: Use typed client SDKs or tRPC / OpenAPI generated clients.
- [ ] Security: Secure cookie session handling, CSRF protection, CORS whitelist.
